title: The Instagram acquisition, in four numbers
subtitle: The same story as the timeline, told so the figures land as figures.
intent: Learners can state what Facebook actually bought in 2012, and explain why the price was not about revenue.

stats.label: Paid by Facebook in April 2012
stats.detail: In US dollars, for a company that had never charged anyone anything.

stats.label: Employees at the time of sale
stats.detail: About 77 million US dollars per head.

stats.label: Revenue at the time of sale
stats.detail: No advertising, no subscriptions, no marketplace.

caption: The price was not paid for the business. It was paid for the audience, and for stopping a competitor owning it. That is the point of the lesson, and it is why revenue is the most useful number on this panel.
source: Company announcements, April 2012. Figures also used in the accompanying timeline. Verify against your unit's prescribed text before use.
